name: 記事末尾のトピック一覧
prompt:
Create a very wide 954 x 217 px component image (aspect ratio about 4.4:1). Use the supplied crop for exact two-row capsule geometry: white canvas; row 1 at y=3 with three pills; row 2 at y=121 with two pills; capsule height about 95 px; gap between adjacent pills about 23 px; the first pill in each row starts at x=0. Keep the soft full-capsule rounded ends and flat, tidy fills from the crop. Target the same compact, wide silhouette: row 1 should end around x=838 and row 2 around x=527. Change only the tag content, typography, and colors to the Japanese Lighthouse version. Use pale mint #ECFDF5 pills with dark teal #0F766E Japanese sans-serif type similar to Meiryo. Render these labels exactly, in this exact order and grouping:
Row 1: 地域の暮らし, 学び, これからの教会
Row 2: 対話, 日々の発見
Center each label within its capsule. Keep text size consistent across all pills; let each pill fit its Japanese label with balanced horizontal padding while staying close to the widths and positions above. No white inset before the first pill, no extra content, no icons, no outline, no shadow, no gradient or texture. All characters must be accurate and fully visible.
reviewNotes: Selected v002 after source/candidate comparison; v001 remains needs-correction because direct aspect fitting flattened pills. V002 uses uniform scaling and row positioning to preserve pill proportions at 954x217; row bands align to source y=2..97 and y=122..216, and row extents end within 10 px of source. Exact five Japanese labels and Lighthouse mint/teal style match the native preview. Natural Japanese label lengths redistribute individual pill widths.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: original screenshot crop defining exact two-row pill geometry
